notes: Named as the active ingredient whose crystal modification I shows the herbicidal action described. No quantity, no characterisation and no purity figure is given in these lines. The section's genus and crop lists are plant names, not compounds, and are excluded: 61 dicotyledonous genera at [0033], 37 monocotyledonous genera at [0034] and 10 crop names at [0035].

Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S, differing only in the crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity but one of the three crystal modifications the patent names. This is modification I, the stable form, and the only modification named in this section. Named as the form showing herbicidal action against monocots and dicots, as the form used to make a crop protection agent against weed infestation, and as the form applied to plants and plant parts. Mentioned in several paragraphs; one merged record. The section's genus and crop lists are plant names, not compounds, and are excluded: 61 dicotyledonous genera at [0033], 37 monocotyledonous genera at [0034] and 10 crop names at [0035].
